programme.title: New: Little House On The Prairie
programme.desc: The Hundred 100 Mile Walk: When their wheat crop is ravaged by a hailstorm, the Walnut Grove men leave town to search for work. Charles hears about a well-paid but dangerous job. (S1 Ep3)

programme.title: New: Little House On The Prairie
programme.desc: Mr Edwards' Homecoming: Charles meets up with Isaiah Edwards, a man the Ingalls befriended on their journey to Minnesota. Back at Walnut Grove Laura is ill in bed, which concerns Mr Edwards. (S1 Ep4)

programme.title: New: The Waltons

programme.title: New: The Waltons

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
